tools.name: record_entry
tools.description: Write down something the next agent or teammate on this project must know: a decision and why it was made, a lesson from something that broke or was reverted, a guardrail (a rule not to break), a note, or a task to be done. Record a lesson whenever a change is rolled back or a fix took real digging,

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Before planning a change, removing code that looks unnecessary, or repeating an approach, search the project's ledger for what was already decided, tried or forbidden. Put the area or change in `query`: any of its words match, best matches first, and a word in an entry's title counts for more than o

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Call this first, at the start of a session, before planning any change. It returns every active guardrail (rules not to break, each with its title and the start of its reasoning, rather than left to a word match), the open and claimed tasks, and the titles of the newest decisions, lessons and notes,

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Take a task before starting it, so another agent or teammate doesn't work on the same one. Give the task's `id` (TASK-n), or leave it out to take the oldest open task. `agent` names who is working on it ("claude-code on dimaino's laptop"). It returns a `claim_token`: keep it. A task claimed by anyon

tools.name: retire_entry
tools.description: Retire a decision, lesson, guardrail or note that is no longer true, so recall stops returning it, or mark a task done. Give its `id` and, for anything but a finished task, a short `reason`. To replace an entry with a new one, use record_entry with `supersedes` instead. Retiring again changes nothin
